absenceReason: Fewer than 40 judged picks; widen the seasons, stretches or NFL rounds, or judge on fewer seasons
baseline: 100% is wins returned by the same overall slots in other draft classes
method: slot-relative ratio estimator, 1.96 standard-error ranges and monotone nine-slot value curve
howCounted: A pick's return is wins above replacement in this league's scoring. Its slot is what the same overall pick returned in the other classes, never its own class. Picks from 2017 onward are judged on their first 2, 3 or 4 finished seasons. A ratio is total returned wins divided by total slot wins; each estimate needs 8 records and 0.5 slot wins. Year 1–5 uses every class with that season recorded, including not-yet-judged picks. The likely range is the ratio plus/minus 1.96 standard errors. Best/worst only beats every other known cell beyond chance; with many cells, a colour alone may be chance. Plays like pick N reads the rounded mean slot's usual value times the return ratio onto a nine-slot-smoothed, never-rising curve. Starter hits are top or starter best seasons versus the same draft stretches; 8 judged picks are required. Kept by year 2 counts only known retention outcomes, including unjudged picks. Draft or buy uses the age-split trade market in these same seasons, not the draft filters; its usual pick round is the most common among judged picks, with stable first-seen ties. Frozen history, not a live pick forecast or ownership claim.
